Bihar Teacher MLC Election Result : bihar vidhan parishad ki char shikshak nirvachan siton ke chunavi natijon men bara badlav dekhne ko mila. charon siton par maujuda MLC chunav har gae. natijon ke mutabik, ek sit BJP aur ek sit RJD ke khate men gaee, jabki ek sit par jan suraj aur ek sit par nirdaliy ummidvar ne jit darj ki.
In natijon men purane chehron ki har aur nae ummidvaron ki jit charcha ka vishay bani huee hai. aakhir shikshak MLC chunav ke natije kya sanket dete hain? dekhie is riport men puri jankari.
